clue.text: Foul smell by one keeping to Bulgarian bread

indicators.note: keeping means holding something within, so the smell word wraps round the next piece

parts.note: a foul smell is a stink
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A bad odour from a single loaf sticking to traditional Bulgarian bread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bread' is slang for money, so the definition is Bulgarian small change, not a loaf.
explanation.definitionFit: Stotinki are the small coins of Bulgaria, and bread is slang for money.

clue.text: Stray animal's spotted on northward journey

parts.note: pied means patchy or spotted in colour

indicators.note: in a down clue, heading north means reading upwards, so the word runs backwards

parts.note: a go can mean a trip or journey

explanation.surface: A wandering dog is seen on a trip heading north.
explanation.definitionFit: A pie-dog is a half-wild ownerless dog of Asian towns, a stray animal.

clue.text: Royal consort gets sanctimonious in early Christian city

parts.note: Prince Philip was consort to Queen Elizabeth II
pi is informal British for piously self-righteous

explanation.surface: A queen's husband becomes holier-than-thou while visiting an ancient Christian town.
explanation.definitionFit: Philippi in Macedonia received one of Paul's letters, an early Christian city.

clue.text: Italy shortly to maintain government's shape

parts.note: I is the international vehicle code for Italy

indicators.note: to maintain is to hold or keep up, so the word for shortly holds the next letter

parts.note: shortly means soon
G is a standard abbreviation for government

explanation.surface: Italy is about to keep the shape of its government.
explanation.definitionFit: An isogon is a polygon whose angles are all equal, a geometric figure.

clue.text: Hurry to get hold of extravagant bed-warmer

indicators.note: getting hold of something means grasping it, so the hurry word surrounds the next piece

parts.note: hie is an archaic verb meaning hurry
OTT, over the top, means extravagant

explanation.surface: Rushing to grab an over-the-top hot-water bottle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bed-warmer' reads as a hot-water bottle but here is an attractive bedfellow.
explanation.definitionFit: A hottie is slang for a sexy person, someone who warms a bed, and also a hot-water bottle.

clue.text: This man turned up dirt for the Sun

parts.note: this man is he

indicators.note: in a down clue, turned up means read from bottom to top, reversing the word

parts.note: dirt means soil

explanation.surface: A man digs up earth in search of sunshine.
explanation.definitionFit: Helios is the Greek god who personifies the sun.

clue.text: Continent's cold precipitation

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on taps
precipitation can mean rash hurry, haste

explanation.surface: Europe's chilly rain or snow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Continent' looks like a landmass and 'precipitation' like weather; the definition is an adjective meaning self-restrained.
explanation.definitionFit: Continent means sexually self-restrained, a synonym for pure and virtuous.

clue.text: Rock singer not finishing with number that's a standard

indicators.note: to rock is to shake about, so the letters are jumbled
not finishing means the last letter of the word is dropped

explanation.surface: A rock star who never ends a song, with a track that's a classic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rock' shuffles SINGE (singer without its last letter) to ENSIG, then N follows.
explanation.definitionFit: An ensign is a flag, and a standard is also a flag or banner.

clue.text: These ladies are willing and game with raciest dancing

parts.note: a test is a match, as in a cricket Test, a game

indicators.note: dancing suggests letters moving about, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Some women are up for a game with the most risqué dancing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Willing' sounds like keen, but here it means making a will; a testatrix is a woman who leaves a will.
explanation.definitionFit: Testatrices are female testators, women who make wills, hence ladies willing.

clue.text: Joyful, having told Republican to get lost

indicators.note: telling someone to get lost sends them away, so that letter is removed

parts.note: related means told, as a story

explanation.surface: Happy after telling a Republican to clear off.
explanation.definitionFit: Elated is a synonym for joyful, in high spirits.

clue.text: Record of proceedings in Brussels is first to earn praise

parts.note: Brussels is the seat of the EU, the European Union
a log is a record of events or proceedings

indicators.note: first to means the opening letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Minutes of meetings in Brussels are the first thing to win plaudits.
explanation.definitionFit: To eulogise is to extol someone highly, a synonym for praise as a verb.

clue.text: Purveyor of romances good for foreigners taking love to heart

indicators.note: taking means receiving inside, so the French word holds the next letter
to heart means into the centre of the word

parts.note: bon is French for good
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A romance writer who's popular abroad by putting love at the centre.
explanation.walkthrough: Mills & Boon is a British publisher of romantic novels.
explanation.definitionFit: Boon is half of Mills & Boon, the British firm famed for publishing romantic fiction.

clue.text: Advice for bed-wetter showing ambition?

definitions.meaning: rise and visit the lavatory, sensible advice for one who wets the bed

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase as a noun means energy and drive, and as an instruction it tells someone to leave the bed.

clue.text: Girl returned damaged article, opposed like 5 across and 25, 6 and 24 etc

definitions.text: opposed like 5 across and 25, 6 and 24 etc

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: a maid is a girl

indicators.note: damaged suggests broken up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A girl sends back a broken item, the complete opposite of what she wanted.
explanation.walkthrough: The listed pairs are opposites: an attractive person versus an old crone, and pure versus raunchy.
explanation.definitionFit: Diametrical means completely opposed, as at opposite ends of a diameter.

clue.text: Gesture theatrically about late running when fare's demanded

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the acting word wraps round the next piece

parts.note: to mime is to gesture as an actor would

indicators.note: running means in disorder here, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A passenger waves dramatically about being late when asked for the fare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fare' suggests a ticket, but here means food.
explanation.definitionFit: Mealtime is the time when food, or fare, is called for.

clue.text: Extremely dexterous on cab's nuts and bolts

indicators.note: nuts means crazy, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: the possessive apostrophe gives no letter

indicators.note: extremely points to the outermost letters of the word

explanation.surface: A skilled mechanic working on the nuts and bolts of a taxi.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nuts and bolts' looks like one hardware phrase, but 'nuts' is the anagram signal and 'bolts' the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To abscond is to run away secretly, and to bolt is to flee.

clue.text: What yours truly does after wearing gussets

indicators.note: after places the setter's activity behind the wearing word

parts.note: in means wearing, as in dressed in
yours truly is the setter, who sets puzzles

explanation.surface: The setter describes dressing in reinforcing patches.
explanation.definitionFit: Gussets are pieces of material set into a garment, which are insets.

clue.text: Old lady supports part of leg in Turkish bath

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece that supports another sits beneath it

parts.note: the ham is the back of the thigh
mam is an informal word for mother, one's old lady

explanation.surface: Mum props up her thigh in the steam room.
explanation.definitionFit: A hammam is a Middle Eastern steam bath, the Turkish bath.

clue.text: Fatigue from worship with leader of Vatican arriving late

indicators.note: arriving late means coming in further along, so the letter moves later in the word

parts.note: veneration means worship

indicators.note: leader of means the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Exhaustion from prayer when the Pope turns up late.
explanation.walkthrough: V, the first letter of Vatican, moves from the front of VENERATION to later in the word.
explanation.definitionFit: Enervation is a state of weakness or exhaustion, synonymous with fatigue.

clue.text: One who holds up royal's crown to help monarch

indicators.note: the crown is the top, in a down clue the first letter

parts.note: aid is help
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A robber goes for a royal's crown to assist the sovereign.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Holds up' suggests support but means robs, as a raider would.
explanation.definitionFit: A raider attacks and robs, someone who holds people up.

clue.text: Raising arm, seize hunk

indicators.note: raising in a down clue means reading upwards, so the word is reversed

parts.note: a gun is a firearm, an arm
get means seize or grab

explanation.surface: Lifting a rifle, grab the beefcake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hunk' suggests a muscular man, but here is a lump.
explanation.definitionFit: A nugget is a lump of gold or other matter, a hunk.

clue.text: Problem joining tin with something more precious

parts.note: Sn is the chemical symbol for tin
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver, a metal worth more than tin

explanation.surface: A difficulty mixing a base metal with a finer one.
explanation.definitionFit: A snag is an unforeseen difficulty, a problem.

clue.text: Lennon's intro in Let It Be, unfortunately, is rubbish

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things gone wrong, so the letters are mixed up
intro means the opening letter of the singer's name

explanation.surface: A critic finds the opening of a Beatles album track poor.
explanation.walkthrough: Let It Be is a Beatles song and album; 'rubbish' is a verb here, as in to criticise.
explanation.definitionFit: To rubbish something is to disparage or belittle it.

clue.text: After grand gambling game, setter's down

indicators.note: after puts the setter's word behind the pieces before it

parts.note: G is slang for a grand, a thousand
loo is an old card game played for stakes
the setter's means my

explanation.surface: Having lost a fortune at cards, the setter is depressed.
explanation.definitionFit: Down means low in spirits, which is the same as gloomy.

clue.text: Like a kitchen where saté is prepared with cry of surprise

indicators.note: prepared means made ready, so the letters are reworked

parts.note: the letters of the dish name, accent ignored
my is an exclamation of surprise

explanation.surface: Satay being cooked in a kitchen to gasps of wonder.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen full of boiling pans is steamy, filled with vapour.

clue.text: Old crone left by date, cracking smile

indicators.note: cracking means breaking into, so the two letters go inside the smile word

parts.note: to beam is to smile broadly
L is left

explanation.surface: An old woman, abandoned on a date, breaks into a grin.
explanation.definitionFit: A beldam is an archaic term for a hag or old woman.
